propositions: The shutdown drain waits only on the webhook queue via queue.join(), leaving reconciler in-flight reviews unprotected when the queue is empty, causing cancellation within ~10s despite a 1200s drain budget.

When any container stop occurs (manual restart, systemd stop, host reboot, autodeploy rollback), a reconciler review mid-pass is killed with no drain, and the silent cancellation leaves no VOTER_ERROR or restarts counter to indicate failure.

The fix implements cooperative shutdown via reconcile.request_stop() to prevent new reviews from starting, then waits on voter.in_flight_reviews() gated by the shared shutdown_drain_seconds() budget before task cancellation, preserving existing queue drain behavior.
The stop flag must clear at the end of shutdown, not at startup, to prevent post-shutdown reconcile_once calls from silently declining to review while reporting candidates as scanned.
The drain uses asyncio.wait with a shared deadline rather than independent windows to keep the total shutdown within the 1320s stop_grace_period against a 1260s floor (1200s drain + 60s store-lock).
